ai.ai_assisted.gui.title: AI Configuration
ai.ai_assisted.gui.test_timeout: §eTest timed out (no response for ~10s) — check the network and try again
ai.ai_assisted.gui.field.ai.enabled.desc: Off leaves only /ai status and help, and the chat prefix stops triggering. Useful to pause AI without deleting the config.
ai.ai_assisted.gui.field.ai.provider.des: openai-compatible / openai-responses / anthropic — hover the selector for details
ai.ai_assisted.gui.provider.desc.openai-: §7Chat Completions, the universal standard: OpenAI itself plus DeepSeek, Qwen, GLM and nearly every compatible service
§7OpenAI's newer Responses API (/v1/responses): the primary interface for gpt-5 / codex models; few third-party services offer it
ai.ai_assisted.gui.provider.desc.anthrop: §7Anthropic Messages API: the official Claude interface; DeepSeek and others also expose compatible endpoints
ai.ai_assisted.gui.field.ai.baseUrl.desc: API root without /chat/completions; a trailing slash is stripped automatically.
ai.ai_assisted.gui.field.ai.model.desc: Model name, e.g. deepseek-chat or gpt-4o-mini. Empty means /ai chat will ask you to configure it first.
Sampling temperature. Lower is steadier, higher is more creative; 0.2-0.7 works well for Q&A.
ai.ai_assisted.gui.field.ai.maxTokens.de: Upper bound on one reply. Too small truncates the answer, too large costs more per call.
ai.ai_assisted.gui.field.ai.chatPrefixEn: Whether to intercept player chat. Off by default: you pay for the key, so intercepting everything costs money and sends chat to a third party.
ai.ai_assisted.gui.field.ai.chatPrefix.d: Only messages starting with this prefix reach the AI. Works together with the toggle above.
ai.ai_assisted.gui.field.ai.toolCallingE: Let the model call read-only lookup tools (blocks, entities, containers). More accurate, but one question may be billed several times.
ai.ai_assisted.gui.field.ai.tool.contain: Let the container search read item contents. Item names are then sent to your third-party API — please be aware on public servers.
ai.ai_assisted.gui.field.ai.tool.adminLe: Minimum level for admin tools; below it they are hidden from the model.
ai.ai_assisted.gui.field.ai.tool.dangero: Let AI propose commands (default off). /ai confirm runs them as you; not undoable.
ai.ai_assisted.gui.field.ai.build.enable: Let AI propose builds (off by default). You confirm with /ai confirm; undoable.
ai.ai_assisted.gui.field.ai.build.allowN: Allow AI to modify/dismantle non-natural terrain (structures). When off, only natural terrain can be overwritten.
ai.ai_assisted.gui.field.ai.build.maxBlo: Volume cap per build, air included.
ai.ai_assisted.gui.field.ai.build.blocks: Blocks placed per tick. Higher builds faster but costs more TPS.
ai.ai_assisted.gui.field.ai.timeoutSecon: HTTP timeout per request, in seconds. Raise it on slow networks; long waits look like a hang to players.
ai.ai_assisted.gui.field.ai.retryCount.d: Retries on failure. Only network errors and 5xx are retried; 4xx is not (retrying never helps there).
ai.ai_assisted.gui.field.ai.replyChunkSi: Characters per reply page. One Minecraft chat line is length-limited, so long answers must be split.
ai.ai_assisted.gui.field.ai.replyInterva: Delay between pages in game ticks (20 ticks = 1s), so a reply does not flood the chat.
ai.ai_assisted.gui.field.ai.requestCoold: Minimum gap in seconds between two requests from the same player, to stop click-spamming.
ai.ai_assisted.gui.field.ai.maxConcurren: How many LLM requests may be in flight server-wide. Higher serves more players and uses more bandwidth.
ai.ai_assisted.gui.field.ai.toolMaxSteps: Max LLM round-trips per message — the worst-case number of billed calls for one question.
ai.ai_assisted.gui.field.ai.toolMaxResul: Max results returned by one tool call, so a whole region of blocks cannot flood the context.
ai.ai_assisted.gui.field.ai.toolMaxScanB: Work budget for the block search, counted in scanned block positions. Tools run synchronously on the server thread and cannot be interrupted, so the work itself is capped.
ai.ai_assisted.gui.field.ai.toolLoopTime: Wall-clock budget in seconds for the whole tool loop. After this it stops calling the model and wraps up.
ai.ai_assisted.gui.field.ai.context.enti: Scan radius in blocks for nearby entities in the context. Larger covers more and is slower to collect.
How many nearby entities to list (sorted by distance).
ai.ai_assisted.gui.field.ai.context.cont: Scan radius in blocks for nearby containers (chests, barrels...).
How many nearby containers to list (sorted by distance).
ai.ai_assisted.gui.field.ai.context.stru: Look up the nearest village. Lets the AI answer village coordinates, but the query shares code with /locate and is not cheap.
Village search radius in chunks. Vanilla /locate defaults to 100; this is more conservative.
How long in seconds each player's village lookup is cached. 0 disables caching.
ai.ai_assisted.gui.field.ai.context.inve: How many inventory summary entries to list, aggregated by item.
ai.ai_assisted.gui.field.ai.history.maxM: Max retained history messages per player; the oldest are dropped first.
ai.ai_assisted.gui.field.ai.history.maxC: Max retained history characters per player, so context and cost cannot grow forever.
ai.ai_assisted.gui.field.ai.memory.enabl: Gives each player a memory file; the model maintains it with memory_write / memory_search / memory_forget (preferences, agreements, project context). When off, the tools are not registered, nothing is injected, nothing is written; existing files are kept.
ai.ai_assisted.gui.field.ai.memory.maxEn: Max memory entries per player; the oldest one is evicted when exceeded. Each entry is truncated to 500 chars on write.
ai.ai_assisted.gui.field.ai.memory.injec: How many of the most recent memories are injected into the system prompt each turn — a fixed token cost per request; older memories are still reachable via memory_search. 0 stores without injecting.
ai.ai_assisted.gui.field.ai.greeting.ena: When a player joins, the AI proactively sends a short greeting (to that player only): their name plus a one-line summary of fresh server data (online count, TPS, their playtime). One LLM call per greeting.
ai.ai_assisted.gui.field.ai.greeting.coo: Minimum interval between two join greetings for the same player, so reconnecting cannot spam your API bill. 0 greets on every join.
ai.ai_assisted.gui.field.ai.permission.a: Minimum permission level allowed to edit AI settings and use /ai admin commands: 0 all, 1 moderators, 2 op, 3 admins, 4 owners.
ai.ai_assisted.gui.api_key_desc: Leave empty to keep the current key; typing replaces it. Write-only and never echoed — use /ai key clear to remove it.
